page.overview:
Who is Chip?

Chip the hamster is a recurring character in the Chocobo series.

Chip is the missing pet of Gamedon, the village smith and storage keeper.

Chip is encountered when taking Chubby Chocobo's shortcut for the first time. If Chip is given a Teleport Tag, Gamedon will double Chocobo's storage space and offer to repair his equipment for a price. Chip will then offer Chocobo to increase the amount of his storage space anytime for increasing amounts of gil, up to 100 storage space.

If a Whistle is used in a dungeon, Chip will deliver a random stored item to Chocobo. Chip also appears in the post-credits scene to introduce Kuz and explain the post-game content.
